formal_statement: ∀ (P L : ℕ) (inc : Fin P → Fin L → Bool) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.IsMonotoneCircuit C → ∀ (j a b : ℕ), C.gates[j]? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [a, b]⟩ → a < P + L + j → b < P + L + j → ∀ w : Fin L, PEqualNP.LowMerge.IsLow P L inc C (P + L + j) w → PEqualNP.LowMerge.IsLow P L inc C a w ∨ PEqualNP.LowMerge.IsLow P L inc C b w
plain_statement: Points then lines are the inputs; inc says which point lies on which line. A wire is low for a line w when, with w the only line on, it is true only on point sets that contain a point of w. In a circuit of AND and OR gates only, if gate h is the AND of exactly two earlier wires a and b and h is low for w, then a is low for w or b is low for w. No property of the incidence is assumed.
title: AND step for low wires: in an AND/OR circuit, an AND of two earlier wires that is low for a line has an operand low for that line
